`inventory.py:36-39`: 🔴 bug: `items.remove(i)` inside `for i in items` skips the element after each removal. Consecutive sold-out items survive. Example: qtys `[0, 0, 3]` returns `[<0>, <3>]`. Fix: `items[:] = [i for i in items if i.qty != 0]`. This keeps the in-place semantics.

🟡 `== 0` misses negative qty from oversold stock. Use `i.qty > 0` as the keep condition if negatives are possible.
